d.ko: Special Agents Mizuki and Ryuki, along with their AI partners Aiba and Tama, are tasked to solve the bizarre Half Body serial killings in this sequel to the critically acclaimed AI: THE SOMNIUM FILES.
d.en: Special Agents Mizuki and Ryuki, along with their AI partners Aiba and Tama, are tasked to solve the bizarre Half Body serial killings in this sequel to the critically acclaimed AI: THE SOMNIUM FILES.
d.zh:
新上任的ABIS特别搜查官瑞希与龙木，
将与眼球型AI机器人搭档――瞳绊与环联手合作，
在过去与现在、梦境与现实之间穿梭，
为了查明真相，开始调查这起【Half Body连续命案】。
